title: bupleurum angulosum f. lancifolium
intro: Bupleurum angulosum f. lancifolium, commonly known as Chinese Thorny Bupleurum or Lancet-leaved Bupleurum, is a plant species within the genus Bupleurum, a group of flowering plants in the family Apiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving liver function, and regulating the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Bupleurum angulosum f. lancifolium include hepatoprotective, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saikosaponins, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
